gen-comfortaa-gf-inclusive-sans: Comfortaa draws its heading like bent neon tube, with a ring-shaped c and loosely stretched spacing. And Inclusive Sans carries the plain sans text smoothly, round letters and open curve ends keeping lines flowing.
gen-comfortaa-gf-inria-sans: Inria Sans runs on tubular strokes, like bent copper pipe. The shared tube-like line is the real hook, linking the display heading Comfortaa to a sans body whose c openings you can see through.
gen-comfortaa-gf-istok-web: Istok Web reads modern and approachable, its rounded letters leaving one side clearly open beneath the Comfortaa display heading. Curves that never thin at the shoulders are the hook.
gen-comfortaa-gf-jost: Neon-tube friendly, Comfortaa stretches its heading wide with a ring-like c. And Jost, a sans-serif with broad terminal gaps and a unit-width stroke, keeps long lines of text moving cleanly.
gen-comfortaa-gf-jura: A ring-like c marks the Comfortaa heading, drawn in neon-tube strokes with loose, stretched spacing. Jura brings plain sans strokes as constant as bent wire, its s curves opening wide at both ends, so text glides.
gen-comfortaa-gf-k2d: Friendly and geometric, Comfortaa stretches out in neon-tube lines. K2D holds a tube-like thickness through every bend, its plain sans c terminals hanging far from the bowl beneath that heading and echoing its tube line.
gen-comfortaa-gf-kanchenjunga: Comfortaa sets a friendly, neon-tube heading, its ring-like c and loose spacing doing the talking. And Kanchenjunga, a sans-serif with the steady line of a technical drafting pen, never clogs at low resolution.
gen-comfortaa-gf-kodchasan: The body text moves smoothly, open terminals hanging free and no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Kodchasan, in plain sans form, keeps the Comfortaa neon-tube heading company without ever tiring the eye.
gen-comfortaa-gf-koho: Comfortaa earns its keep big and short, where curves and straights share one line width. KoHo, a sans with wide c apertures, takes over the quieter text without competing.
gen-comfortaa-gf-kosugi: Friendly and geometric, Comfortaa draws a ring-like c and stretched spacing in neon-tube lines. But Kosugi, a plain sans with an open-jawed c like pliers, gives it a wire-bent counterpart.
